metadata.title: त्रिपुरा: छात्र किस भाषा के लिए लड़ रहे हैं? Tripura : Students protest for tribal language
metadata.description: In this insightful interview, we sit down with the leader of the Tiprasa Student's Federation (TSF) to delve into the significance of their protest in Agartala, where they are advocating for the adoption of the Roman script for the Kokborok language. Kokborok holds a crucial place in the cultural and linguistic landscape of the tribal population of Tripura. The TSF leader passionately explains the rationale behind their demand, highlighting how transitioning to the Roman script could play a pivotal role in preserving the identity and heritage of the community while also easing language learning and communication. This conversation provides valuable context to the ongoing debate and sheds light on the broader implications of script choices for indigenous languages.
